threat_event: Attacker uses the turbine vendor's standing remote access path at Plant P3 to reach the turbine control system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing vendor remote access with no method to detect malicious communications (CIP-003-9 Attachment 1 Section 6.3; scenario gap 3)
existing_controls: Vendor access can be disabled at the plant firewall (Section 6.2); vendor identity in SYS-G1
treatment_plan: Move vendor access to group PAM with session approval; OT sensor rules for vendor sessions; self-report and mitigation plan (POAM-013)

threat_event: Malware enters a plant DCS from an OEM field engineer's laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transient cyber asset reviews of OEM laptops are not recorded (CIP-003-9 Attachment 1 Section 5.2)
existing_controls: Plant procedure requires a scan before connection; company laptops managed with antivirus (Section 5.1)
treatment_plan: Recorded review checklist for every third-party transient cyber asset; company scanning kiosk at each plant (POAM-014)

threat_event: The Generation Control Center is lost and dispatch instructions are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GCC dispatches 1,180 MW; backup GCC function in the P1 control room
existing_controls: Backup GCC function at P1; telephone dispatch from the market operator; plants hold last setpoint
treatment_plan: Semiannual switchover drill to the backup GCC
owner: Power Generation Vice President of Generation

threat_event: Ransomware in corporate IT forces the GCC and plants to isolate from corporate networks, or reaches their OT DMZs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GCC and plant OT DMZs are reachable from the shared jump servers and the data platform connector (GR-01, GR-02)
existing_controls: Plant control does not depend on corporate networks; OT sensors at the GCC
treatment_plan: Division-only jump servers and read-only historian push (GR-01, GR-02); isolation drill with the market operator
owner: Power Generation security and compliance lead

threat_event: The bidding SaaS fails during the day-ahead window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One bidding platform; servers in provider A
existing_controls: Market operator backup interface; phone procedure
treatment_plan: Quarterly drill of the backup offer procedure

threat_event: A NERC CIP violation is found or reported late and penalized more heavily because evidence is incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Evidence for Section 5.2 reviews and Section 6 methods incomplete since 2026-04-01
existing_controls: NERC compliance team; 2024 audit without findings
treatment_plan: Self-report possible noncompliance with a mitigation plan; internal evidence checks each quarter

threat_event: The OEM turbine anomaly model misses a developing fault or raises false trips
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OEM model runs on the vendor's remote monitoring service
existing_controls: Operators decide on every alert; OEM engineers review alerts
treatment_plan: Track alert accuracy each quarter in the AI inventory (P10)

threat_event: An unauthorized person enters a plant control room
existing_controls: Badge access, cameras, staffed control rooms
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Power Generation security and compliance lead (Low): CIP-003-9 Section 2 controls are in place and were audited without findings
owner: Power Generation security and compliance lead

threat_event: A cyber incident at the third-party gas processor interrupts residue gas to the plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plants buy residue gas from one processor under a netback contract
existing_controls: Plants can switch to pipeline gas
treatment_plan: Test pipeline gas switchover each year; contract notice clause

threat_event: A new unit or a planner designation changes a plant's impact rating and the program does not keep up
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Largest plant 640 MW; GCC 1,180 MW; both well below the 1,500 MW bright lines
existing_controls: CIP-002 review every 15 months approved by the CIP Senior Manager
treatment_plan: Add a CIP-002 impact check to the generation project gate

threat_event: A plant engineer changes DCS logic without authorization
existing_controls: Plant change procedure; DCS audit trail
treatment_plan: Monthly comparison of DCS configuration with the approved baseline

threat_event: Malware arrives on removable media used at a plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Removable media used for OEM data and reports
existing_controls: Scanning kiosks at each plant (Section 5.3.1); media blocked on HMIs
